topics.topic: Canonical run-answer schema across APIs (which fields are always included, including waiting-approval and release metadata)
questions: When the element is waiting for owner approval, must this operation also return the waiting approval_id (so runs can build run answers without reading effect-owned records directly)?
Are `released_by` and `released_at` part of the standard run-answer schema everywhere (including `runs.read_run`, `get_run`, `list_records` on runs), or only appended by `runs.release_run`?

quotes: A run's answer, wherever an operation returns one, holds: `run_id`, the flow version, status, starter and times, outputs produced, waiting points with their reasons and, for `owner_approval`, the `approval_id` of the element's `requested` approval — one always exists while it waits (A10 rule 2), and once ended the reason per missing output (A13 rule 7).

Its conclusion: succeeded with outputs; failed with its status, or with `applied_outputs_unknown` for an attempt resolved applied whose binding has outputs; waiting with its reason; or not reached when the element has no NodeExecution yet (A11 rule 3).

Its answer as Conventions define a run's answer — `approval_id` included for `owner_approval` — outputs in flow output port name order and waiting points in (`node_id`, `map_index`) order: status, outputs produced as StoredValue references — `surface` resolves them for the reader — waiting points, and once ended the reason per missing output, `skipped_by_guard` or `not_produced` (A13 rule 7).
judgement.divergence: Behavior A: all run-answer producers treat `approval_id`, `released_by`, and `released_at` as canonical fields and include them in `runs.read_run`, `get_run`, and `list_records`; Behavior B: only `runs.release_run` returns release metadata and operation-element waiting conclusions expose only reason, so other run-answer paths may omit those fields or force separate lookups. Owner and agent callers notice different run payloads and approval workflows.
judgement.why: The texts require a uniform run answer in one place but do not fully specify these fields in all producing operations, so careful implementers can return observably different answers.

topics.topic: Error-surface boundary for credential-resolution failure during `prepare_request`
questions: When credential resolution fails during request preparation, is that surfaced as a refusal from `installation.resolve_service_credential`, or as a non-refusal pre-send failure result returned by `prepare_request`?

topics.topic: Exact per-relation call signatures for `store.read_records` (required/optional/forbidden args)
questions: For each relation in "Relations of `store.read_records`", what is the exact required argument list and field names (including optional/forbidden args), so invalid-shape calls are determined uniformly?

topics.topic: NodeExecution/WaitingPoint identity semantics for omitted `map_index` on mapped vs non-mapped nodes
questions: When APIs name/read NodeExecution-like records, is `map_index`-absent valid only for non-mapped nodes, or also for mapped-node node-level records (empty-map / skipped / upstream_failed)?
Which services are included in that ordered set: all services present in installation credentials, all with selected instances, union of both, or another set?

topics.topic: Standard machine-readable result schema for non-refusal check operations
questions: What exact machine-readable result format (discriminator fields/enums/detail fields) must these operations return so callers can branch deterministically without parsing prose?

topics.topic: Whether `internal_error` is subject to the same no-prior-writes rule as refusals
questions: Is internal_error outside the 'refusal writes nothing' rule, or must operations guarantee no prior writes when returning internal_error?

topics.topic: Whether `runs.capture_failed_execution` must validate/resolve references before copying bytes (vs copy-then-refuse)
questions: If the named contract version is unknown (or otherwise fails inside `functions`), must `runs.capture_failed_execution` check that before copying bytes, or may it copy bytes first and then return `unknown_reference`/`refused` from `functions`?

topics.topic: `functions.roll_back_slot` unknown-reference precedence when multiple references are invalid
questions: If both slot and implementation references are bad/missing, which missing reference must be reported as `unknown_reference` first?

topics.topic: `get_flow` response scope for active flows (full FlowVersion graph vs activation metadata only)
questions: For an active flow, does get_flow return the full active FlowVersion graph or only activation metadata/ids?

topics.topic: `get_repair_view` continuation rules when page size changes between calls
questions: If the caller changes page size between continuation calls for get_repair_view, is that allowed (as in list_records) or refused for this operation?

topics.topic: `read_spooled_file` behavior when caller-provided digest/size/media_type disagree with stored file metadata
questions: If the caller supplies digest/size/media_type that do not match the located SpooledFile record, should the call refuse or ignore those descriptive fields?
